test_title: PYST 28: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: The average weight of 23 students was recorded as 53 kg. On including the weight of a teacher, the average weight increased by 100 g. Find the weight (in kg) of the teacher.
solution:
Given:

The average weight of 23 students was recorded as 53 kg. On including the weight of a teacher, the average weight increased by 100 g.

Concept used:

Total = Average × Number of entities

Calculation:

Total weight of 23 students = 23 × 53

⇒ 1219 kg

100 g = 0.1 kg

New average including the teacher = 53 + 0.1 = 53.1 kg

Now, the weight of the teacher = 53.1 × (23 + 1) - 53 × 23

⇒ 55.4 kg

∴ The weight of the teacher is 55.4 kg.
